providers.title: Quadratic stabilization (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For a >= 2, b >= a(a-1) and every finite-dimensional complex V, the map Sym^b(Sym^a V) -> Sym^a(Sym^b V) is surjective. Proved in the last lesson.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: An equivariant embedding (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For a >= 2 and b >= a(a-1) there is an injective GL(V)-equivariant linear map Sym^a(Sym^b V) -> Sym^b(Sym^a V). Proved in the last lesson.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Averaging
providers.scope: Averaging identifies Sym^k W with the symmetric tensors in W^(x)k, naturally in W.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Polarization
providers.scope: k! u_1...u_k is the alternating sum of (sum over J of u_j)^k over subsets J; pure powers span Sym^k W.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The image
providers.scope: The image of the Foulkes–Howe map is spanned by the powers P^a of products P of b vectors.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The diagonal criterion (OpenAI)
providers.scope: The map is surjective if and only if every symmetric a-linear form on Sym^b V vanishing at (P, ..., P) for all products P of b vectors is zero.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Fischer inner product
providers.scope: Differentiation by X_k and multiplication by X_k are adjoint for the inner product with ||X^alpha||^2 = alpha!.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Differential injectivity (OpenAI)
providers.scope: On polynomials homogeneous of degree p in U and q in Y, possibly in further variables, the operator sum_k Y_k d/dU_k is injective when p > q.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Vanishing on products (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For b >= a(a-1), a symmetric a-linear form on Sym^b V vanishing on the diagonal at all products of b vectors is zero.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
